name: Analytics Mates
description: Agency + product behind The Helm, an analytics layer on Google Analytics data for digital marketing and e-commerce managers. Pitch: free GA4 audit, then paid product starting at $999 per website property (company-stated). Google Marketing Platform partner (founder-stated). Founded 2024, US. ~100 estimated users.

mentions.evidence: ~$3,148 MRR, 4 active subscriptions, ~$26,823 L30 (+50.2%), ~$70,269 last 3 months, ~$257,480 last 12 months, ~$692,718 all-time, ~50% L30 profit margin. Revenue synced Oct 9, 2026 ~05:05 Warsaw (03:05 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: A PL/EU "GA4 / GTM cleanup + monthly KPI pack" for mid-size shops on Shoper / IdoSell / Shopify, sold as a €790 setup + €190/mo retainer. EventDash-adjacent: sell the audit that surfaces "your purchase event is broken," then upsell cookieless analytics.

whyItPrints: GA4 broke a lot of in-house reporting; teams pay for someone to make the numbers usable again. L30 (~$27k) ≫ MRR (~$3.1k) strongly suggests audits / implementation packs on top of a few seats — same pattern as Comp AI. L30 revenue is up 50.2%.
